item.title: Xiaomi Launches Smart Switch 2 With Plexiglass Panel and Single/Zero-Wire Auto-Adapt
item.description: Xiaomi's Smart Switch 2 starts crowdfunding at CNY69, offering acrylic-glass panels, single- or zero-wire self-adaptation, Mesh 2.0, and faster response in a switch that works with Xiaomi's smart-home ecosystem.

item.title: Why the 'Brain' of China's AI Runs on a Grassland: Inside Alibaba's Ulanqab Data Center
item.description: Alibaba's Ulanqab data center shows how cheap renewable power and low latency—about 4 milliseconds to Beijing—are making a remote Inner Mongolia city into a center of gravity for China's AI compute.

item.title: iFLYTEK Open-Sources Million-Token Context Models for On-Device AI
item.description: iFLYTEK's wholly-owned subsidiary launched and open-sourced Spark X2.5-4B and X2.5-1.7B, which it says are the first edge models to natively support up to one million tokens of context.
